paragraph: [Angola's National Director of Registries said all 21 provinces can now issue and print identity cards locally](<https://angolanewswire.com/angolan-government-issues-more-than-17-million-citizens-identity-cards/>). In the last twelve months, daily production rose to 60,000 cards after technical upgrades, he said in September 2026. [In April 2025 it printed 12,000 cards a day against a capacity of 20,000](<https://angop.ao/noticias/politica/ministro-reafirma-aposta-na-atribuicao-de-bi-a-todos-os-cidadaos/>). The report does not say whether national staff or a supplier carried out the upgrades. No source found says the system runs on code the state owns. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[ANIP, attached to the presidency, is in charge of all identity matters in Benin](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/building-digital-id-systems-that-last-african-countries-share-experiences-as-id4africa-2026-opens>), its Director General said in May 2026. [The single national identity database and the national civil status file are both managed by ANIP](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named, and no source found says who maintains the system or who holds its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The national identification office, ONI, runs enrolment for the AES biometric identity card](<https://www.fasoamazone.net/2026/09/15/id-day-2026-loni-ouvre-plusieurs-sites-denrolement-a-ouagadougou-face-a-laffluence-pour-la-cib-aes/>). In September 2026 it opened nine extra sites in Ouagadougou. In the last twelve months, enrolment began for a new unique identifier. [The digital transition ministry runs the enrolment for the new unique electronic identifier, launched on 11 November 2026](<https://www.sidwaya.info/2026/11/11/operation-denregistrement-de-masse-de-lidentifiant-unique-le-capitaine-ibrahim-traore-lance-loperation-denrolement/>). In October 2024 the minister had only said steps were being taken to entrust it to local expertise. No source found says who maintains the system. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The Minister said in July 2026 that the ministry runs card production with its own personnel and extended hours](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/92439>). [It received P105 million in 2026 to produce Omang cards](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/90334>). [The ministry engages suppliers only for equipment maintenance](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/92439>), the Minister said, and the suppliers are not named. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says national staff maintain the system itself or who holds its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[ONECI, under the Interior Ministry, manages the national population register and assigns the identification number](<https://www.aip.ci/cote-divoire-aip-le-gouvernement-mise-sur-le-parae-pour-renforcer-la-confiance-dans-les-services-publics-numeriques/>), the PARAE coordinator said in October 2026. [ONECI said in May 2026 that the RNPP has run since 2019 as a public-private partnership with Semlex as operator](<https://sitetest.oneci.ci/actualites/2026/05/07/1778155208-mise-en-uvre-du-rnpp-loneci-et-ses-partenaires-dfinissent-les-orientations-stratgiques-2026>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. [ONECI's director general said in May 2026 that the national databases are maintained with money from ONECI's own budget](<https://www.linfodrome.com/societe/121311-id4africa-2026-l-oneci-presente-les-avancees-du-systeme-ivoirien-d-identification-numerique>). He did not say who carries out the work. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[A February 2025 decree gives the head of the national identity-title production centre the administration of the system](<https://www.prc.cm/files/7f/4b/5b/2ce7f303c8e3bd44fa83c05acf9ddbf9.pdf>). The centre is attached to the national police. [Augentic signed a 15-year build-operate-transfer contract with the police in May 2024](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202405/cameroon-hands-15-year-biometric-id-card-contract-to-augentic>). It will hand the equipment and infrastructure over once its operating period ends. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says national staff maintain the system or that the state owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The IDEMIA and Afritech consortium produces the cards and manages the general population file](<https://www.bbc.com/afrique/articles/cy633p6ezq1o>), under a 20-year contract, BBC News Afrique reported in May 2024. [In March 2024 ONIP said it would manage the national data centre and population file](<https://scooprdc.net/2024/03/27/rdc-lonip-presente-le-plan-de-mise-en-oeuvre-du-programme-de-fichier-general-de-la-population-et-de-la-delivrance-de-la-carte-didentite-nationale-aux-congolais/>). [Trident says its subsidiary develops and operates the RDC-PASS digital ID under a 20-year partnership with the government](<https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/18/3314133/0/en/Trident-Digital-Tech-Holdings-Nasdaq-TDTH-Activates-National-RDC-PASS-Digital-Identity-Ecosystem-in-the-Democratic-Republic-of-Congo-Under-20-Year-Public-Private-Partnership.html>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No transfer to national staff is reported. Preparing would need national operation to be a stated goal, or a transfer of skills announced, while a supplier still runs it.

[The Finance Ministry relaunched production of the NIU card in September 2025](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/fr/articles/relance-des-operations-de-production-de-la-carte-niu>). [A 2024 decree has the cards produced only by national production centres at Brazzaville, Pointe-Noire and Oyo](<https://natlex.ilo.org/dyn/natlex2/natlex2/files/download/117585/COG-117585.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named. No source found says who maintains the system or who holds its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The Dutch firm GenKey took over production of ID cards and passports on 31 March 2026](<https://alwatwan.net/societe/production-de-documents-biom%C3%A9triques-genkey-succ%C3%A8de-officiellement-%C3%A0-semlex.html>). The interior minister said this would bring a transfer of skills to national staff. In the last twelve months, GenKey replaced Semlex, the producer since 2007. [A week earlier Semlex, the producer since 2007, handed the data to the government](<https://alwatwan.net/societe/confection-des-papiers-biom%C3%A9triques-i-semlex-remet-les-donn%C3%A9es-au-gouvernement.html>). The data are now hosted in Comoros. No source found says national staff maintain the system or that a national authority runs it day to day. Establishing would need the national authority to operate the ID system day to day, even on a platform built abroad.

[In September 2025 the government's Resolution 95/2025 authorised the national press, INCV, to take over buying, personalising and issuing the electronic ID card](<https://tiver.cv/incv-inicia-producao-de-documentos-eletronicos-de-identificacao/>), with the residence permit and e-passport. The press built a security printing plant for the work, financed with a state-backed loan. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says who runs or maintains the national ID system, or whether the state owns its code. Establishing would need the national authority to operate the ID system day to day, even on a platform built abroad.

[The DGPF's own agents run enrolment, checks and duplicate resolution on the national register](<https://www.lanation.dj/carte-nationale-didentite-biometrique-dans-les-coulisses-de-la-nouvelle-identite-nationale/>), the head of its central NNI service said in July 2026. [The DGPF has issued the biometric national ID card across the territory since 2025](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named, and no source found says who maintains the system or who holds its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The central collection and processing systems were developed by Algerian engineers](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf>), the Interior Ministry said in May 2026. [Its own engineers administer the platforms that collect and centrally process identity data](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T2-3-S3-4-Algeria-FINAL.pdf>). No foreign operator is named for the day-to-day running of the system, and no foreign supplier is named as the owner of its code. No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is the ministry's own account of May 2026.

[The national number project is run with technicians of the Civil Status Organization](<https://www.citc.com.eg/National%20ID%20SYSTEM.html>). CITC, an Egyptian company, supports its main computers and the card production centre. [The interior ministry's Civil Status Sector issues and renews ID cards itself](<https://www.moi.gov.eg/news/GetDetails?newsId=db391b26-33f2-44ab-bd3b-7818d08d6cb7>), it said in February 2025. CITC published its account of the project in 2024. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the system runs on code the state owns. Mature would need the ID system in service to run on code the state owns: built in-house, on open source such as MOSIP, or with the code handed over.

[In August 2026 the national ID authority became Faydaverse, a government-owned enterprise](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/fayda-digital-id-nears-50m-enrollments-as-adoption-reshapes-ethiopias-economy>). [Fayda runs on MOSIP, the open-source identity platform](<https://kanatelevision.com/news/what-is-faydaverse-the-ethiopian-national-id-program-that-became-a-company-and-how-it-plans-to/>), Kana TV News reported in August 2026. [The ID programme said in 2024 that local engineering teams provide Fayda's technical solutions](<https://id4africa.com/2024/ps1/PS1-1-Ethiopia-final.pdf>). In the last twelve months, the programme became an enterprise, and [a May 2026 deck says the programme office and the new enterprise would run in parallel](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-1-Ethiopia-FINAL.pdf>). The latest dated fact is the August 2026 report on Faydaverse.

[The National Identification Authority sets fees and runs first-time registration, card replacement and record updates](<https://nia.gov.gh/fees-and-charges-2026/>), it said in January 2026. [Margins Group told MPs in 2024 that it built the registration system while the NIA operated it](<https://www.graphic.com.gh/news/politics/ghana-news-parliament-cttees-commend-margins-id-group-for-ghana-card-investment.html>). [The NIA's own PKI team carried out updates to the Ghana Card registration system in 2026](<https://www.classfmonline.com/news/NIA-announces-temporary-nationwide-service-disruption-for-system-updates-74362>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the system runs on code the state owns. Mature would need the ID system in service to run on code the state owns: built in-house, on open source such as MOSIP, or with the code handed over.

[NG Tech Innovation says its teams are in Conakry to train national cadres and transfer skills](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/07/identite-numerique-loneci-et-ng-tech-innovation-scellent-un-partenariat-strategique-pour-le-rnpp/>), a July 2026 report says. The same report says Guinean engineers developed the register's infrastructure. [ID Tech Wire reported in March 2026 that Guinea's national ID is built on MOSIP](<https://idtechwire.com/guinea-launches-biometric-birth-certificates-in-sanoyah-in-civil-registry-modernization-push>), an open-source identity platform. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says a national authority operates the ID system day to day. Establishing would need the national authority to operate the ID system day to day, even on a platform built abroad.

[The Gambia Immigration Department rolls out the new biometric card, and its officers run the enrolment centres](<https://foroyaa.net/gambians-welcome-biometric-id-rollout/>). [Margins' subsidiary MIDSA won the contract in January 2026 to design, deploy and operate the system](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202607/the-gambia-launches-sovereign-digital-id-system-built-by-margins-id-group>). In the last twelve months, Margins replaced Semlex. [In September 2024 the interior minister said the Semlex contract had ended and was not extended](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202409/details-of-the-gambias-national-id-card-contract-plan-emerge>). [Margins will co-operate the system for eight years and transfer all assets at the end](<https://standard.gm/new-id-card-to-get-10-years-validity/>). Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The Justice Minister inaugurated an ID-card production centre in Bolama in June 2026](<https://ang.gw/regioes-ministro-da-justica-inaugura-centro-de-producao-de-bilhete-de-identidade-em-bolama/>), the 18th issuance centre in the country. [Semlex Guinea-Bissau said in July 2024 that it produces and enrols the ID cards under a partnership with the justice ministry dating from 2006](<https://www.semlex.com/en/2024/07/01/nouveau-centre-denrolement-a-bissau/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named in the June 2026 report. No source found says who maintains the system or who owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[CNEDOGE issues the biometric national identity document](<https://www.hayderechoenguinea.com/noticias/sociedad/sobre-el-funcionamiento-del-centro-nacional-de-emision-de-documentos-oficia>). It is an autonomous public body attached to the Ministry of National Security. A 2024 account says it also installs, controls and manages the issuing and checking devices across the country. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named, and no source found says who maintains the software or who holds the code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The National Registration Bureau produces identity cards at its Nairobi headquarters](<https://www.vividvoicenews.com/2026/10/03/bungoma-id-registration-hampered-by-staff-vehicle-and-equipment-shortages/>), a county registration officer said in October 2026. [In June 2024 the National Registration Bureau was printing ID cards at its own Nairobi centre in 24-hour shifts](<https://www.tv47.digital/govt-adopts-24-hour-ids-printing-to-clear-backlog-59752/>). [In November 2023 a principal secretary said the government had declined foreign firms' offers to build Maisha Namba](<https://www.kbc.co.ke/business-rivalry-blamed-for-digital-id-misinformation/>), preferring local experts. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says who maintains the system or who holds its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The National Identification Registry owns and operates the national biometric identification system](<https://www.africa-newsroom.com/press/liberia-president-boakai-declares-wednesday-september-16-as-national-identification-day?lang=en>), set up by 2011 legislation. [Its Executive Director said in September 2026 that the NIR administers the system, with OeSD as technology partner](<https://allafrica.com/stories/202609080549.html>). [OeSD would operate and maintain it before handing it to the government](<https://www.liberianobserver.com/politics/house-begins-review-of-boakai-s-proposed-national-digital-id-overhaul/article_0c964a7e-9e8c-4c1e-9e05-46bfae096890.html>), under a proposed concession that was still awaiting ratification in late 2026. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says national staff maintain the system or that the state owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The Civil Registry Authority, a national body, issues the unique National ID Number to all Libyans](<https://libyaherald.com/2024/09/pm-aldabaiba-follows-up-on-intilaqa-project-for-matching-civil-registry-electronic-data-with-paper-records>), the Libya Herald reported in September 2024. [National numbers have been issued since 2011 through a unified electronic system under the authority](<https://alwasat.ly/news/479468>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named, and no source found says who maintains the system or who owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

No stage is set. Pangea's maintenance contract for the ID system ended in December 2024, and a new company took over. No source found says who that company is or who runs the system now. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company shown to maintain and upgrade the ID system, since the end of the foreign contract alone leaves open who runs it.

[The DGSN issued nearly 4.7 million electronic national ID cards in 2024](<https://www.moroccoworldnews.com/2024/12/166797/dgsn-issued-record-4-6-million-digital-ids-slashed-crime-rates-in-2024>). [The national population register runs on the open-source MOSIP platform](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Collaborations_between_Governments_and_Academic_Institutions.pdf>). [A Moroccan university unit, UM6P's MOSIP Centre of Excellence, holds the interior ministry's contract for support and code changes to the national population register](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Collaborations_between_Governments_and_Academic_Institutions.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is the 2026 MOSIP report, which says the register was extended to all 83 provinces in October 2022.

[The DECIM page of 2026 describes a transfer still in preparation](<https://decim.mg/actualites/enrolement-biometrique-a-madagascar-capitaliser-les-acquis/>). [The DECIM project's next phase prepares the gradual transfer of responsibilities and ownership to national institutions](<https://decim.mg/actualites/enrolement-biometrique-a-madagascar-capitaliser-les-acquis/>). A national steering committee steers it, and DECIM now finances the work. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says the national authority operates the ID system day to day or who maintains it. Establishing would need the national authority to operate the ID system day to day, even on a platform built abroad.

[ANSAEC, the national agency, administers the RAVEC database](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T2-P1-S2-3-MALI_FINAL.pdf>), the civil register directorate said in May 2025. The system is Mali Kura Biométrie, launched on 13 February 2024. [No foreign provider is on the maintenance contract for Mali Kura Biométrie](<https://malikonews.com/mali-mali-kura-biometrie-un-nouveau-systeme-numerique-souverain-des-donnees-ravec/>), according to the coordinator of the volunteer expert committee. [The government says national experts hold its source codes and licences](<https://bamada.net/donnees-administratives-le-mali-recupere-ses-fichiers-ravec>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The latest dated fact is [Aujourd'hui-Mali reported in August 2024 that a Malian company makes the biometric ID card and Malians control the whole chain](<https://www.maliweb.net/nation/confection-de-la-carte-didentite-biometrique-confiee-a-une-societe-malienne-vers-la-nationalisation-du-passeport-malien-3072499.html>).

[The National Directorate of Civil Identification produced 856,101 national identity cards in the first half of 2026](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-dnic-produces-over-800-thousand-national-identity-cards-in-the-first-semester/>). It received 813,307 applications in that period. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No foreign operator is named, and no source found says who maintains the system or who owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[UNDP says the National Agency for People Registry and Secure Documents, under the Ministry of Home Affairs, manages the national biometric system](<https://www.undp.org/blog/mauritania-pilots-digital-id-app>). [The agency took the system offline for a day of preventive maintenance in August 2026](<https://techrek.info/fr/houwiyeti-de-nouveau-operationnelle-de-la-maintenance-periodique-a-la-question-de-la-souverainete-numerique/>). It announced the outage in advance. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says whether agency staff or a supplier did the work, or who owns the code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The National Identity Card Unit registers people and issues the national identity card and mobile ID](<https://mnis.govmu.org/>), an account of February 2024 says. It also provides card-reading services to other agencies. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No supplier is named, and no source found says who maintains the system or who owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The National Registration Bureau manages the national civil registration and digital identity system](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P3-S2-3-Malawi_FINAL.pdf>). [In December 2025 its Principal Secretary said it would renew, print and distribute about two million expired ID cards](<https://malawi24.com/2025/12/25/government-extends-validity-of-expired-national-id-cards-to-2027/>). [UNDP handed the system's source code to the Bureau in October 2018](<https://malawi24.com/2026/09/26/nzika-wallet-controversy-who-holds-the-keys-to-malawis-multibillion-digital-identity/>). No source from the last three years confirms that handover. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found says who maintains the system. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The Ministry of Home Affairs, through its civil registration department, runs the e-ID card application and issuing, including amendments and replacements](<https://www.namibian.com.na/ministry-of-home-affairs-clarifies-e-id-costs/>), it said in July 2026. [It printed 166,237 between 1 April 2025 and 30 June 2026](<https://neweralive.na/ministry-takes-id-registration-to-khomas-schools/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says national staff maintain the system. None says the foreign contract has ended. None says the code is state-owned. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[Niger launched its new biometric ID card on 25 April 2026](<https://anp.ne/niger-lancement-officiel-de-la-carte-didentite-nationale-biometrique-aes-a-niamey/>). A Libyan company, Alitisal Aljadeed, produces it, the national press agency reports. [In March 2026 the Libyan firm's engineer said it trains local teams to take over](<https://www.lesahel.org/projet-des-nouveaux-passeports-et-cartes-biometriques-du-niger-le-secretaire-general-du-ministere-de-linterieur-visite-les-services-concernes-pour-apprecier-letat-de-mise-en-o/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says national staff maintain the ID system or that a national authority runs it day to day. Establishing would need the national authority to operate the ID system day to day, even on a platform built abroad.

[NIMC says the identity database is hosted in Nigeria and managed by NIMC employees, not vendors](<https://techcabal.com/2026/10/14/nimc-identity-database-locally-hosted/>). [NIMC's Alvan Ikoku said in October 2026 that NIMC maintains its core database internally with its own staff](<https://techcabal.com/2026/10/14/nimc-identity-database-locally-hosted/>). In the last twelve months, this account replaced an earlier position. [In April 2024 NIMC renewed Idemia's three-year contract to upgrade the biometric system and provide maintenance and support](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202404/idemia-upgrading-nigerias-national-biometric-system-to-handle-250m-ids>). No source found says the system runs on code the state owns. Mature would need the ID system in service to run on code the state owns: built in-house, on open source such as MOSIP, or with the code handed over.

[NIDA leads nationwide enrolment for the new digital ID](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202606/rwanda-accelerates-biometric-enrollment-ahead-of-digital-id-switch>), Biometric Update reported in June 2026. [In October 2025 its field teams ran enrolment in Nyanza, Huye and Gisagara](<https://www.nida.gov.rw/news-details/nida-has-officially-launched-digital-id-activities-in-the-southern-province-beginning-with-nyanza-huye-and-gisagara-districts>). [A March 2026 tender for the card printing system includes training so that NIDA can sustain it after the contract](<https://securedocumentnews.com/news/2026/mar/23/rwanda-issues-tender-for-id-system/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No supplier is named, and no source found says who maintains the system or who owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The National Electronic Authentication Authority manages the platform and takes monitoring and enforcement action](<https://sudapass.gov.sd/terms?lang=en>). In the last twelve months, Sudan launched SudaPass, its national digital identity platform, on 21 May 2026. [In August 2024 the police said the fingerprint system behind new national numbers belongs to Dermalog and must be run by its German staff](<https://awalalnahar.net/archives/22743>). [The terms give all rights in the platform and its source code to the competent authority and/or its licensed entities](<https://sudapass.gov.sd/terms?lang=en>). No source found says national staff maintain SudaPass or that the state alone owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

[The DAF, a national directorate, resumed making national identity cards on 1 April 2026](<https://aps.sn/la-daf-annonce-la-reprise-de-la-confection-des-cartes-nationales-didentite-depuis-le-1er-avril/>). In the last twelve months, production stopped after a cyberattack in February 2026 and then resumed. [Its technical services restored the system](<https://aps.sn/piratage-informatique-la-daf-annonce-la-suspension-provisoire-de-la-production-de-cartes-nationales-didentite/>). No source found says national staff maintain the system or that the state owns its code. Operating would need the authority's own staff or a national company to maintain and upgrade the ID system, or the foreign contract to have ended.

No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says national staff or a national company maintain the system, or that the foreign contract has ended. [Somalia's National Identification and Registration Authority runs registration and issues the national ID](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2026/Sep/206316/somalia_registers_15_million_citizens_under_national_id_system.aspx>). It launched the card as eAqoonsi in September 2023. [The three launched systems, HUBIYE, e-Aqoonsi and CDS, were entirely developed by Somali engineers at NIRA](<https://nira.gov.so/news/nira-launches-key-digital-public-infrastructure-for-national-id-system>), its Director General said in May 2025. [In February 2026 NIRA agreed a framework with China that includes transfer of technical skills to Somali staff](<https://sonna.so/en/article/director-of-nira-meets-with-chinese-ambassador-to-advance-national-id-system-and-digital-cooperation>). In August 2026 it launched a school-based campaign in Juba.
